jobs.title: Experienced Software Engineer – Java/.NET Platform
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced software engineer to join the team responsible for developing the software platforms underlying COMSOL Multiphysics®. You will work with the runtimes, libraries, build systems, and platform integrations that form the foundation of a large, cross-platform engineering software product. The majority of the development is done in Java and C#, together with build and automation tooling.

**About COMSOL**
----------------

COMSOL develops cutting-edge mathematical modeling software that powers innovations in physics and engineering. Our flagship product, COMSOL Multiphysics®, is widely used across all fields of engineering, manufacturing, and scientific research to model multiphysics systems. Our customers leverage our software to understand, predict, and optimize product designs and processes. Founded in Sweden in 1986, COMSOL has expanded globally with 16 offices employing more than 500 people worldwide.

**Role**
--------

Based in our newly renovated office in central Stockholm, you will join the core group developing the user interface, communication, and data layer functionality of the COMSOL product suite. The group is also responsible for the Application Builder, Model Manager, COMSOL Server, and COMSOL Compiler functionality, which customers use to create, manage, deploy, and run simulation models and apps.

In this role, you will work on several of the software platforms on which our products are built. This includes the Java and .NET runtimes and their ecosystems, third-party libraries, database connectivity and persistence technologies, application launchers, build systems, and integration of vendored software. The work spans multiple operating systems and a large codebase with a long development history.

You will evaluate and integrate new runtime and library versions, investigate compatibility issues, implement or backport APIs and other changes where needed, and develop automation that makes recurring platform and dependency work more efficient and reliable.

The role also provides opportunities to evolve the platforms themselves. Depending on your experience and interests, this can include introducing new platform capabilities and APIs, improving how runtimes and third-party components are integrated, evolving build and development infrastructure, and finding better ways to support development across the product organization. You will have room to identify improvements and contribute to the longer-term technical direction of the areas you work with.

Responsibilities include writing and reviewing code, investigating platform and compatibility issues, contributing to technical specifications and design, developing build and platform infrastructure, and testing changes across the supported product platforms.

**Qualifications**
------------------

For this position, we are looking for an experienced software engineer with the following qualifications:

* M.Sc. or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or physics.
* Excellent programming skills with proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language.
* Several years of professional software development experience.
* An interest in working with complex software systems and improving the technical foundations on which other development depends.

Experience with the following will be highly valued:

* Large software projects and mature codebases.
* Java and/or .NET runtime environments and their library ecosystems.
* Build systems, dependency management, and software packaging.
* Cross-platform development on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
* Integrating or adapting third-party and open-source software.
* Build and development automation.
* Designing or evolving software platforms, frameworks, or developer infrastructure.

No background in physics or simulation is required. At COMSOL, you will be part of a company where software developers, mathematicians, physicists, and engineers work together to develop software for science and engineering.

**Working at COMSOL**
---------------------

At COMSOL, platform engineering is closely connected to product development. You will work on technical foundations used throughout the COMSOL product suite, with opportunities both to ensure that those foundations remain robust and current and to improve how they support future product development. Decisions about runtimes, libraries, build systems, and operating-system support have a direct impact on a complex engineering product with a long lifetime.

New team members quickly become essential contributors to ongoing development projects. As the company continues to expand, there are plenty of opportunities for employees to advance in their roles and become leading experts in their areas of focus. This journey will be accompanied by experienced colleagues and a collaborative working environment.

We also offer:

* A competitive salary
* Individual pension plans
* Sponsored gym membership
* Work-life balance with regular working hours

To ensure a smooth onboarding process, onsite presence is required. Once onboarded, hybrid work options are available.

**To Apply**
------------

Does this sound interesting? Submit your application in English or Swedish Make sure to include:

* Cover letter
* CV
* University diploma with grades

Please include your university diploma with grades, regardless of when the degree was obtained. Kindly note that applications submitted through other channels will not be considered.

To recruiters, please note that the target channels for this position have already been selected.

For more information, contact Mikael Sterner at tel. 08-412 95 00.

We review applications continuously.



**Reference**

REF-10051

  

**Job title**

Experienced Software Engineer – Java/.NET Platform

  

**Location**

Stockholm, Sweden

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
Full-Stack Analist-Developer
jobs.description:
Beschrijving

**Functie**
-----------

De Supporting Services departementen vormen een belangrijke basis voor de verdere groei van de bank. HR, Finance, Risk, Audit, Legal, Compliance, Logistics, Tax/Fiscal en het Transformation Office hebben elk hun eigen ambities, processen en ontwikkelingsnoden.

Als Full-Stack Solution Engineer werk je in een nieuw, compact development team. Op basis van de business requirements die door de Business Analyst worden voorbereid, verfijn je de functionele analyse en ontwikkel je de oplossing. Je werkt rechtstreeks samen met business stakeholders en neemt end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid, van analyse en implementatie tot release, monitoring en support.

**Verantwoordelijkheden**
-------------------------

**Functionele analyse en solution shaping**

* Vertaal business requirements naar duidelijke functionele specificaties, user flows en implementeerbare oplossingscomponenten.
* Verduidelijk noden en edge cases samen met de Business Analyst, Subject Matter Experts en eindgebruikers.
* Draag constructief bij aan scope, haalbaarheid en oplossingskeuzes binnen de architecturale richting van het domein.

**Full-stack development en kwaliteit**

* Ontwikkel onderhoudbare, veilige en schaalbare applicaties met C#, .NET, Angular en TypeScript.
* Pas degelijke engineering practices toe op vlak van coding, review, documentatie en kwaliteitsborging.
* Gebruik GitHub en GitHub Copilot actief om samenwerking, consistentie en AI-ondersteunde development te bevorderen.

**Delivery en operationele ownership**

* Deploy applicaties via de beschikbare standaard release structuren en templates.
* Monitor, ondersteun en verbeter je applicaties na release: you build it, you run it.
* Onderzoek incidenten en feedback, en vertaal ze naar duurzame verbeteringen.

**AI-enabled oplossingen en samenwerking**

* Integreer AI capabilities in business oplossingen door gebruik te maken van het interne AI platform en de herbruikbare services ervan.
* Werk nauw samen met de Senior Full-Stack Developer & Solution Architect, de Business Analyst en de Domain Architect.
* Deel kennis en herbruikbare patterns naarmate de Supporting Services development capability groeit.

**Profiel**
-----------

We zoeken een medior of senior full-stack engineer die functionele analyse combineert met hands-on development en die zich comfortabel voelt bij het opnemen van ownership in een nieuw team.

Je hebt een stevige ervaring met C#, .NET, Angular, TypeScript en GitHub. Affiniteit met AI is essentieel, zowel voor het integreren van AI-functionaliteit als voor het gebruik van tools zoals GitHub Copilot in je dagelijkse engineeringwerk. Ervaring met API's of applicatie-integratie is een troef. Kennis van een of meerdere Supporting Services domeinen is een plus.

**Competenties**
----------------

Je bent een analytische, hands-on professional die het leuk vindt om business noden om te zetten naar betrouwbare software.

* Analyse en communicatie: je structureert complexe noden en communiceert helder met zowel business- als IT-stakeholders.
* Engineering quality: je hecht belang aan onderhoudbaarheid, beveiliging, kwaliteitsborging en operationele stabiliteit.
* Ownership: je werkt zelfstandig, maakt voortgang zichtbaar en blijft verantwoordelijk na go-live.
* Samenwerking: je werkt als één team met je collega-developer en zoekt actief feedback en domeinkennis op.
* Learning mindset: je neemt nieuwe technologie pragmatisch op en gebruikt AI om zowel oplossingen als manieren van werken te verbeteren.

**Positionering binnen de organisatie**
---------------------------------------

De Full-Stack Solution Engineer rapporteert binnen het Supporting Services domein en:

* werkt nauw samen met de Business Analyst om business requirements te verfijnen tot functionele specificaties;
* werkt samen met de Senior Full-Stack Developer & Solution Architect op vlak van solution design en implementatie;
* stemt af met de Domain Architect over architecturale principes en belangrijke technische keuzes;
* werkt rechtstreeks samen met Subject Matter Experts en stakeholders binnen Supporting Services.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern – Device Simulation & Digital Twin (February 2027)
jobs.description:
Company Description

At KEENFINITY Group
, we are a globally leading provider of innovative and professional security and communication solutions. With over 4,000 employees in over 50 countries worldwide, our ambition is clear: we offer more than just technology – we secure, connect, and amplify the moments that matter in life.

Our Audio business is part of the Keenfinity Group and operates as an independent company – giving our iconic brands the independence and agility to thrive in today’s market. As part of a global family that includes Bosch, RTS, Electro-Voice, Dynacord, and Telex
, we deliver world-class professional audio, building safety, intercom, and communication solutions that connect concerts, broadcasts, houses of worship, stadiums, and schools. We develop and manufacture these systems in our own plants across Europe, the Americas, and Asia.

Our vision is to be the industry’s most admired company, driven by customer success. We strive to live and work according to our core values of Customer Success, Passion, Boldness, and Integrity.

Customer Success: Unmatched customer experience, end to end.

Passion: We love what we do, it drives everything we deliver.

Boldness: We challenge the status quo. We innovate. We lead.

Integrity: We do the right thing. Always.

What’s in it for you?

Working with us means experiencing the best of both worlds: the global impact and prestige of industry-leading brands, combined with the agility and entrepreneurial energy of a newly independent company. In this dynamic environment, your ideas will not get lost in bureaucracy. We empower you to take true ownership, accelerate your growth, and collaborate with passionate experts worldwide to build solutions you can genuinely be proud of.

Job Description

As a Software Engineering Intern – Device Simulation & Digital Twin
, you will help us rebuild and significantly expand the software simulator for our DICENTIS conference devices
. The simulator acts like real hardware on the network, allowing our development and test teams to validate server behavior, run automated regression tests, and develop software without always needing access to physical devices.

We already have an existing simulator, but it currently covers only a limited set of device behaviors and runs on an aging technology stack. Your project will be to rebuild it using a newer technology foundation that we are already investing in, while expanding its coverage from approximately 30% to 80–90% of real device behavior
.

You will work on a long-term project with a tangible impact on how our engineering teams develop, test, and maintain our products. The final solution will run on both Windows and Linux
and become an important part of our automated testing and development environment.

During Your Internship, You Will

Get familiar with the existing device simulator, DICENTIS devices, and the newer technology stack used for the rebuild.
Analyze the behavior and capabilities of real devices and identify which scenarios are already simulated and which are still missing.
Define and prioritize the device behaviors required to significantly expand simulator coverage.
Design and implement new simulated device scenarios using C# and/or C++.
Develop software that communicates over the network and behaves like the corresponding physical devices.
Make the simulator compatible with both Windows and Linux.
Develop and maintain automated tests that use the simulator as a replacement for physical hardware.
Integrate the simulator into our automated build and test pipeline, including continuous integration where applicable.
Document supported device behaviors, architecture, usage, and known limitations.
Work closely with engineers and testers to understand their needs and ensure the simulator is practical for everyday development and testing.
Break down a long-term project into manageable milestones and provide regular progress updates to your supervising team.

Qualifications

You are currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related technical field.
Solid programming skills in C# and/or C++.
Good understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles.
Basic understanding of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, client-server communication, and networked devices.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and break down a larger project into manageable steps.
Good written and spoken English communication skills.
Motivation to learn, investigate technical problems, and develop a solution from an existing foundation.

It Is a Plus If You Have

Experience with .NET or .NET Core.
Familiarity with network protocols or device communication standards.
Experience with automated testing or continuous integration tools such as Jenkins.
Experience working in a Linux-based development environment.
Coursework or project experience in software engineering, networking, embedded systems, or distributed systems.
An interest in audio, conferencing technology, embedded systems, or connected devices.

Additional Information

💼 What We Offer:

A hands-on internship in an international team.
Close guidance from experienced professionals.
A dynamic role where your input and ideas are appreciated.
The option to work from home one day per week.
An internship allowance between €500 and €600 per month (based on full-time employment).

📝 Application Process

Interested? Hit the apply button!
Phone meeting with a Keenfinity Group campus recruiter;
Interview with team members;
Contract offers from Keenfinity Group.

🌱 Join us at KEENFINITY!

At Keenfinity Group we don’t just build innovative solutions — we shape a smarter, more connected world through technology.

We value different backgrounds, ideas, and experiences and we’re committed to growing, learning, and celebrating success as one team. Everyone is welcome here — we foster an environment where everyone is respected, valued, and encouraged to be their authentic self.

Keenfinity is an equal opportunity employer, offering equal opportunities for all. We welcome applications from people with disabilities and can offer support, if needed. When everyone has a chance to contribute, we all do better.
